capabilities: Pin a linked source paragraph as an approved baseline
Scan saved pins for literal text changes in the source
Compare approved and current text side by side before re-approving
Group pins into named project review groups (Pro)
Write dated Markdown review reports to the vault root (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a fact-checker or web page monitor; it only compares literal text of local Markdown paragraph blocks and says nothing about a source's reliability or remote changes.
extras: Freemium: named review groups and dated reports require a $5/month or $15 GitHub Sponsors sponsorship; free scans keep working if Pro lapses. Until GitHub sign-in the plugin makes no network requests and has no telemetry. The What's new tab promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat but can be turned off. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later.
problem: Obsidian links and embeds do not warn you when the paragraph a conclusion depends on has been edited since you read and approved it.
summary: Passage change checker that pins approved source paragraphs from other notes and scans whether their literal text changed since approval.
